description: Models the BlankFinalOptimizedProviderComplexSample E2E case. Both a STATIC provider (STATIC_BLANK_FINAL) and a DYNAMIC provider (static2, representing a static initializer block) must precede the same dependent (B_STATIC_READ). A free STATIC item (staticNoise) should sort after the full {STATIC_BLANK_FINAL, static2, B_STATIC_READ} chain.
